assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square tabletop battlemap enemy token portrait. Primary request: an original dark-fantasy portrait of a D&D 2014 chimera, a single readable three-headed creature with a lion front, goat rear and leathery dragon wings, shown as one cohesive silhouette. Scene/backdrop: nearly black smoky cavern with a subtle ember glow. Subject: fierce lion, goat and dragon heads, natural anatomy, no rider or extra creature. Style/medium: painted dark-fantasy concept art with crisp silhouette and restrained texture. Composition/framing: centered bust-to-torso view, circular-safe margins, subject readable at small UI size. Lighting/mood: dramatic warm rim light from below, ominous. Color palette: charcoal, dark umber, muted bronze and ember orange. Materials/textures: fur, horns, scales, leathery wings. Constraints: one creature only, no text, no border, no logo, no watermark, no copied franchise art; 1:1 square composition. Avoid: collage, multiple creatures, extra heads beyond the three natural heads, modern objects, photorealistic gore.
